name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) is the only Existence and is required. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) puts the box after the unlock. The two hard Precedence clauses put the ball and the key before the unlock with no order between them, as in either order requires. The hard chain forces door_open, blocker_moved and has_door_key, so no extra Existence is needed and the compiler reports no redundancy.

texts: Pick up the box in the other room, the mission's target box, as the final goal.
Pick up the target box only after the door has been unlocked.
Unlock the door only after the blocking ball has been picked up; the ball and the key may come in either order.
Unlock the door only after the key has been picked up; the key and the ball may come in either order.
